title: Repository lookup via PreparedStatement with try-with-resources
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the unclosed Connection field as a leak. The repository deliberately does not own the connection — its lifecycle belongs to the caller/pool that constructed the repository — while everything this method creates (the PreparedStatement and the ResultSet) is closed by nested try-with-resources on every path. The user id is bound as a parameter, never concatenated, so the query is not injectable, and an absent row maps to Optional.empty rather than null.
